import bpy, math, json
import numpy as np
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['harbor_craft']
exec("""
D=160; PAD=6; SIZE=4096
palette={'wall':(128,99,74),'frame':(83,64,47),'trim':(124,103,78),
         'roof':(110,88,66),'deck':(128,107,81),'door':(108,102,85),
         'cargo':(129,105,77),'cargo_frame':(98,78,57),'barrel':(122,97,70),
         'inner':(66,51,37)}
roughness={'wall':.87,'frame':.88,'trim':.86,'roof':.90,'deck':.88,
           'door':.82,'cargo':.88,'cargo_frame':.86,'barrel':.87,'inner':.93}
def family(name):
    if name.startswith(('Craft roof board','Canopy broad course')):return 'roof'
    if name.startswith(('Craft roof batten','Window ','Front window','Side window','Vent jamb')):return 'trim'
    if name.startswith(('Painted cargo door','Open shutter')):return 'door'
    if name.startswith(('Front siding','Side siding','Rear siding','Craft gable infill')):return 'wall'
    if name.startswith('Gable ') and not name.startswith(('Gable vent','Gable backing')):return 'wall'
    if any(s in name.lower() for s in ['inner','interior','lining','backing']):return 'inner'
    if any(s in name.lower() for s in ['freight','shelf cargo']):
        return 'cargo_frame' if any(s in name.lower() for s in ['batten','brace']) else 'cargo'
    if 'barrel' in name.lower():return 'barrel'
    if name.startswith(('Veranda board','Entry tread','Work rack shelf','Work bench top','Pile endgrain')):return 'deck'
    return 'frame'
def is_timber(o):
    return o.type=='MESH' and o.data.materials and (o.data.materials[0].name=='HarborCraft_Timber' or o.data.materials[0].name.startswith('HarborCraft_Joinery_'))
plans=[];patches={}
for o in c.objects:
    if not is_timber(o):continue
    if 'stave ' in o.name or 'rim' in o.name.lower():continue
    verts=np.array([tuple(v.co) for v in o.data.vertices])
    lo=verts.min(axis=0);hi=verts.max(axis=0)
    assert len(verts)==16,('Unexpected timber shape',o.name,len(verts))
    role=family(o.name)
    seed=sum((i+3)*ord(ch) for i,ch in enumerate(o.name))
    variant=seed%5
    if role=='roof':
        variant=[2,2,3,1,1,2,0,2,3][int(o.get('course',seed%9))%9]
    groups={}
    for poly in o.data.polygons:
        normal=np.asarray(tuple(poly.normal));axis=int(np.argmax(abs(normal)));sign=1 if normal[axis]>=0 else -1
        groups.setdefault((axis,sign),[]).append(poly.index)
    for (axis,sign),polys in groups.items():
        axes=(0,1) if axis==2 else ((0,2) if axis==1 else (1,2))
        length=float(hi[axes[0]]-lo[axes[0]]);width=float(hi[axes[1]]-lo[axes[1]])
        if length<1e-6 or width<1e-6:continue
        kind='end' if axis==0 or (axis==2 and o.name.startswith('Pile endgrain')) else ('face' if axis==2 else 'edge')
        pw=max(2,math.ceil(length*D)+1);ph=max(2,math.ceil(width*D)+1)
        key=(role,kind,pw,ph,variant)
        if key not in patches:patches[key]={'role':role,'kind':kind,'pw':pw,'ph':ph,'variant':variant}
        flip=axis==2 and role in ['wall','roof','door'] and o.matrix_world.col[axes[1]].z<0
        plans.append(dict(object=o,axes=axes,lo=lo,polys=polys,key=key,flip=flip,length=length,width=width))
x=0;y=0;rowh=0
for key,p in sorted(patches.items(),key=lambda pair:pair[1]['ph'],reverse=True):
    w=p['pw']+PAD*2;h=p['ph']+PAD*2
    if x+w>SIZE:x=0;y+=rowh;rowh=0
    assert y+h<=SIZE, ('Atlas does not fit',y+h,len(patches))
    p.update(x=x+PAD,y=y+PAD);x+=w;rowh=max(rowh,h)
print('PHYSICAL_UV_LAYOUT',{'density':D,'atlas_size':SIZE,'patches':len(patches),'surface_groups':len(plans),'packed_height':y+rowh})
""",ns)
